decisions.statement: A potion whose item link carries its effects is known by unpacking them rather than by a table.
An item link packs up to three alchemy effect ids, one to a byte, highest byte first.
The highest byte carries 128 more where the potion took three reagents.
A byte of 0 is an effect the potion does not have.
A potion whose item link carries no effects is known by item id.
Four of the game's alchemy effects restore something and the rest restore nothing.
The item id table is written out from the alchemy and mined-item pages rather than by hand.
The game addon and the web matcher read one module.

definition: which resources a potion restores, unpacked from its item link or read off its item id
